Description:
[b]更新 Updated：
01/22[/b]
1.稍微修改了地图，现在不会窗户不会出现黑边了
2.根据需求，增加了无joja的版本，可以通过[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]进行调整

1. The map has been slightly modified. Now there will be no black edges on the windows.
2. According to demand, a no-joja version is added, you can adjust it by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].
3. Fixed the issue that the grass color is still the vanilla color when using recolor mod.
————

[b]Thanks to Surrealo for the authorization![/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13868]Surrealo Original link[/url]

There may be issues with teleporters when using different farm room mods.It is recommended to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip[/url] and press F11 to pass through the wall.

When you open it for the first time, there are barrels. You need to use a pickaxe to knock them off.
One with storage room, one without, you can adjust it by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

感谢Surrealo老师的授权！

使用房型mod时，传送可能会出现问题。建议使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip[/url]并按F11穿墙。

当你第一次打开它时，里面有小桶。你需要用镐把它们敲下来。
 
有带储藏间和不带的版本，可以通过[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]调整。
